description: Ex-TRIP Linhas Aéreas ATR 72-212 (c/n 454) written off after a gear collapse at Altamira on 21 Feb 2011; fuselage installed in the plaza from 2014 and opened 10 Apr 2016 as a snack bar ('Avião Expresso'). Listed as a tourist attraction by the Prefeitura de Altamira (2025) and in a Feb 2026 survivors compilation.
